overview: Tumble Maze is a marble-tilting game across three wooden mazes. Roll a steel sphere toward the route’s end while collecting stars, avoiding open sinkholes and accounting for moving sweep bars. A clock, par times and collected stars determine the score.
rules: Tilt changes the effective downhill direction and rolls the marble rather than directly moving it.
Collect stars while navigating maze walls and sweeping bars.
A sinkhole swallows the marble and adds five seconds.
Par time, elapsed clock and stars determine scoring across three mazes.
story: This is a mechanics-led puzzle or activity; the available game source does not establish a narrative campaign or named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
